message.reasoning:
The user wants to compute the logarithm of the distance with base 20? Wait: "將距離的對數以先前燃料值為底" means "take the logarithm of the distance with the previous fuel value as the base". But then says "計算精度為10。使用20為底". That seems contradictory: they want log(distance) with base 20? Or maybe they want log(distance) with base equal to the previous fuel value?
